refnamediv.refpurpose: Waits for events on the watched handles

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
timeout
The maximum time to wait. A zero duration makes the method return immediately, and &null; waits without a time limit.
maxEvents
The maximum number of watchers to return in one call. With &null;, the backend chooses a value based on the number of watched handles. The other watchers that are ready are not returned by this call.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns a list of the Io\Poll\Watcher objects that were triggered, or an empty &array; if none was. The events of each watcher are available from Io\Poll\Watcher::getTriggeredEvents and Io\Poll\Watcher::hasTriggered.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if timeout is negative.
Throws a ValueError if maxEvents is less than 1 or greater than 2147483647.
Throws an Io\Poll\FailedPollWaitException if the backend fails to wait for events.
